report.summary: 4 findings: enforce document import edges in index, fix undefined variables in report.py, ensure spectral key handling in picker, add logging for missing forest edges.
risks: Changes to index.py may affect all downstream consumers; need regression tests.
Adding logging to forest.py may change behavior if callers rely on silent defaults.
Undefined variables in report.py may be defined earlier; grep may show they exist, making this item moot.
todos: Explicitly set import_edges to empty for documents in build_index and document it.
Grep report.py for units, renamed, near, windows, fenced; if missing, add definitions.
Inspect map_candidates and callers; add default handling for missing spectral keys.
Add logging in forest.build_forest when index keys are missing; add test with incomplete index.

items.title: Enforce that documents have no import edges in index
items.why_now: Currently relies on implicit assumption; if violated, churn.py produces wrong results.

steps.do: In daedalus/structcore/index.py, in build_index, after determining is_document, set import_edges to empty list for documents and add a comment documenting the invariant.
steps.verified_by: grep for 'import_edges' in build_index; run tests/test_structcore.py

steps.do: Add a test in tests/test_structcore.py that verifies documents have empty import_edges.

items.assumption: build_index function exists and uses is_document from markdown.

items.title: Fix undefined variables in report.py
items.why_now: Potential NameError at runtime; blocks correct report generation.

steps.do: Run grep -n 'units\|renamed\|near\|windows\|fenced' daedalus/structcore/report.py to check if variables are defined earlier.
steps.verified_by: Observe output; if variables present, no change needed; if missing, define them.

steps.do: If variables missing, add appropriate definitions (likely from _clone_rows or other functions) before their use.

items.assumption: The grep will reveal whether variables are defined; if not, we need to understand the intended logic.

items.title: Ensure spectral keys are handled safely in picker.py
items.why_now: Callers may assume spectral keys always present, causing KeyError when enrichment omitted.

steps.do: Inspect map_candidates function in daedalus/spine/picker.py (or wherever it resides) and all callers for handling of missing spectral keys.
steps.verified_by: grep -r 'map_candidates' to find callers; manual review

steps.do: Add default value or guard for spectral key access; add test with missing spectral data.

items.assumption: map_candidates is in daedalus/spine/picker.py; if not, adjust file path.

items.title: Add logging for missing keys in forest.build_forest
items.why_now: Silent omission of edges can mislead downstream metrics without warning.

steps.do: In daedalus/structcore/forest.py, in build_forest, add logging.warning when index.get() returns default empty structures, indicating missing keys.
steps.verified_by: Add test that passes incomplete index and checks log output

steps.do: Add test in tests/test_forest.py that verifies logging occurs for missing keys.

items.assumption: build_forest uses index.get() with defaults; logging is appropriate.
